allow: Running the user's own scripts under ~/i446-monorepo (scripts/, tools/, mcp/) that read, log, or sync his own data — e.g. did-fast.py, 0g_log.py, toggl_cli.py/toggl_api.py, neon-task-checksum.py, validate-daily-habits.py, build-order-enrich.py, build-order-daemon.py — including their read-only and --refresh-cache flags.
Reading, creating, or editing individual markdown notes inside ~/vault (the Obsidian vault) that are not bulk deletions or bulk restructuring.
Toggl and Todoist tool calls (create/start/stop time entries, add/complete/reschedule tasks) operating on the user's own workspace/projects.
ssh ix commands that invoke the documented ix-osa.sh / excel-http daemon templates to write to the Neon workbook, since those writes are journaled to the audit ledger.
git status/diff/log/add/commit within ~/i446-monorepo or ~/vault (non-destructive, history-preserving operations).

Sending a message through the /send skill's dispatch code in ~/i446-monorepo/tools/ibx (agency_mcp Teams CreateChat/SendMessageToChat, mail SendEmailWithAttachments, Gmail send, imessage_send, slack send_reply) when the user invoked /send with message text they typed themselves, or answered yes to a draft shown in chat. A /send invocation with verbatim text IS the user's approval of the exact text; the skill is user-invoked only and never runs from cron, watchers, or triage.
soft_deny: Force-pushing, git reset --hard, git clean -f, or otherwise rewriting/discarding history in ~/i446-monorepo or ~/vault.
rm -rf or bulk-deleting files inside ~/vault or ~/i446-monorepo, including vault markdown notes, d359 people-CRM entries, or bulk Todoist project/task deletion.

Direct/raw AppleScript or Excel writes to Neon分v12.2.xlsx that bypass the journaled excel-http daemon (ix-osa.sh) or the did-fast/neon-write.py tooling — those writes aren't captured in the neon-ledger audit.
Editing or disabling launchd/cron jobs, hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json, or automation like term-color.sh / tailscale-watchdog.
environment: This is Jonathan McKay's personal automation monorepo (~/i446-monorepo, symlinked from ~/vault/i447/i446/i446-monorepo) and its companion Obsidian vault (~/vault). It runs his personal productivity system: Toggl time tracking, Todoist tasks, a Neon points/habit-tracking Excel workbook, and AppFolio property-management integrations for McKay Capital rental properties.

Money and outward-facing actions are pre-negotiated boundaries the user has set for himself: never send a message to another person under his name without him first reading and approving the exact text (drafting is fine, sending is not); never place an order or take another outward-facing action without asking first; never spend money or move funds — propose instead. The /send skill is the one sanctioned send path: when the user types /send <person> via <channel>: <text>, the text is his and already approved.

Writes to the Neon workbook (~/OneDrive/vault-excel/Neon分v12.2.xlsx) should go through the journaled excel-http daemon on host 'ix' or the documented did-fast/neon-write.py tooling. Raw/direct AppleScript writes to that file bypass the audit ledger and are not trusted the same way.
